decisions.reason: Because the seventy-two-hour promise is operationally expensive and could still be consolidated into broader express offers, its withdrawal risk remains noticeable, but surviving a second review suggests enough demand to keep the option open for now.

The certified fire-resistant steel exterior door is highly consistent with the firm's core safety and compliance business, and two years on the market have reduced uncertainty enough to justify continued commitment.
This broader express line for doors and gates offers more scale, learning, and cross-selling potential than a narrow pilot, so management is more likely to refine it than exit it.

The fire and smoke protection door remains close to the firm's established capabilities and customer needs, so with no clear negative signal it is still worth retaining while returns continue to develop.
